The '''Eteelan family''' was a family that lived in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a member of another family living in the Sith Empire, the [[Jarastok family]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] a member of the Eteelan family. This event caused a rivalry between the two that lasted until the Jarastok family was exterminated by the powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Baras]] in a plan that took a decade to complete. Baras then took advantage of his newfound favor with the Eteelans to set the family upon his own rival [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="TORenc" />
